I believe that growing the pipeline is the single most impactful action a company can take to achieve consistent growth. To accomplish this, we’ve devoted significant attention to refining our processes, testing various products, and continuously iterating throughout the company’s lifetime. [...] We started working with Ciro a few months ago, and thanks to their product, we’ve been able to simplify our sales operations and prospecting processes, reducing the workload from four people to just one, while simultaneously accelerating sales and more than doubling our revenue. Ciro has become an essential part of our sales stack, and their monthly bill is one I’m more than happy to pay.

As a bonus, working with @Richard Lee @Ross Geiger and @David Winer has been fantastic.

They are super responsive and clearly passionate about what they do.

10/10 – love the product!

Chandan
CoinTracker

CoinTracker

Interesting, @mezrlee, cool launch. Out of curiosity: [...] More examples for different industries, roles, and sales motions would help teams understand how to get the best results from the platform.

Overall, Ciro is solving an important part of outbound: helping teams spend less time building lists and more time reaching the right prospects.

#### vs Alternatives

The alternatives are usually a mix of tools like Apollo, Clay, spreadsheets, and different data providers.

Those tools are useful, but getting the right filters, search criteria, and workflow setup often requires a lot of manual effort.

Ciro feels more focused on helping teams move from identifying their ideal customer profile to building a usable prospect list faster.
